name: PMEGP
purpose: Support new micro-enterprises through credit-linked subsidy assistance.
eligibility: Individuals, self-help groups, institutions, and eligible entrepreneurs starting new units.
benefits: Project-linked bank finance with subsidy support depending on category and location.

name: Mudra
purpose: Provide loans for micro and small businesses through Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun categories.
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises needing business finance.
benefits: Collateral-light finance for working capital, equipment, expansion, and business operations.

name: Startup India
purpose: Support eligible startups with recognition, compliance benefits, and ecosystem access.
eligibility: Eligible innovative startups meeting DPIIT recognition criteria.
benefits: Recognition, tax and compliance benefits where applicable, learning resources, and ecosystem access.

name: Stand-Up India
purpose: Enable bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs starting greenfield enterprises.
eligibility: SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up eligible greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Bank loans for manufacturing, services, trading, and allied activities.

name: CGTMSE
purpose: Provide credit guarantee support for collateral-free loans to eligible MSEs.
eligibility: Eligible micro and small enterprises receiving lender-approved facilities.
benefits: Credit guarantee cover that helps lenders finance eligible businesses without traditional collateral.

name: MSME Registration
purpose: Formalize micro, small, and medium enterprises through Udyam registration.
eligibility: Businesses meeting MSME investment and turnover criteria.
benefits: Recognition for schemes, tenders, credit support, delayed payment protection, and formal ecosystem access.
